notes: Check 1: no Clarity election list for Hays (elections.json 404). The county Elections page (hayscountytx.gov/172/Elections, CivicPlus) links only an 'Election Results Archive' (Archive.aspx?AMID=53), whose entries (for example 'May 26, 2026 Primary Runoff', 'March 3, 2026 Primaries', 'November 5, 2024 General (ZIP)') hold only official files: 'Official Canvass Results', 'Official Cumulative Results', 'Official Results Reports (ZIP)', CVR export, certification and reconciliation. This server stamps every page with the request time as Last-Modified, so it gives no upload evidence. One web search listed an egovlink.com-hosted 'Cumulative Results - Democratic Party - unofficial' PDF for the 2026 primary, but that URL now returns 404, and a livevoterturnout.com/HaysTX election-night site that only covers November 2020 (Last-Modified 2022). No election-night file for the three target elections could be read. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin). Targeted pass 2026-10-02 (targeted-Hays): no election changed. Tried: (1) livevoterturnout.com/HaysTX/LiveResults/en/Index_5.html source: static page, data embedded inline (precinctData = per-precinct check-ins/turnout, not candidate votes), electionIdVar 5, updated 11/4/2020; directory URLs return 403; no data files for 2024-2026 elections, so this vendor site is not where Hays posted the target elections. (2) Wayback harvest branch: one election-night capture, hayscountytx.gov/elections/20260303 at 2026-03-03 20:35 CST (the county used a Duda site at /elections/YYYYMMDD then; it now 404s after a move to CivicPlus): 'All EV locations reporting / ED locations reporting: 0 / 35' with only 'Cumulative Reporting' links to egovlink unofficial cumulative PDFs (now 404). This shows county totals posted on election night, but the capture predates any election-day results, so it cannot show whether precinct numbers came later that night; 2026_primary stays UNDETERMINED (lead toward LATER). No 2024 general capture (CDX connection refused; in 2024 the county site was hayscountytx.com, which the harvest did not target and which the fetch module reports unreachable) and no runoff capture. (3) phase1/targeted/archives/Hays and phase1/targeted/wayback/Hays: not on the wayback-data branch at start or at finish (checked three times). Wayback CDX from here is refused by the fetch module. (4) Check 4: Hays Free Press 2026 primary (updated 23:14 election night) and University Star 2024 live updates give county totals only; KUT runoff page gives county totals only; Fox7 2024 page had no precinct numbers; Wimberley View, Dripping Springs News and Hays Free Press 2024 pages return 404. No third-party per-precinct numbers found. Leads: web search listed egovlink 'Cumulative Results - 20260526 Dem unofficial.pdf' (runoff) and, for the Nov 2025 election (not a target), 'Canvass Results Unofficial.pdf', which suggests Hays sometimes posts unofficial precinct canvass reports; all such egovlink files now 404. Later Wayback captures of hayscountytx.gov/elections/20260303 and /20260526, hayscountytx.com election pages (Nov 2024), and egovlink.com/public_documents300/hayscounty/published_documents/departments/elections/results/ would decide these elections. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-C): no election changed. Tried: (1) Wayback availability API and replay for the egovlink unofficial cumulative PDF linked from the 2026-03-03 20:35 CST capture: archive.org returned HTTP 429 and web.archive.org is refused by the fetch module (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). (2) egovlink.com directly: the unofficial primary file ('.../results/2026/0303 Primaries/Cumulative Results - Republican Party - unoffcial.pdf') still returns 404 and the folder listings '.../0303 Primaries/' and '.../0526 Primary Runoff/' return 403; only the official runoff cumulative ('.../0526 Primary Runoff/Official Cumulative Results - Republican Party 20260526 Primary Runoff.pdf', hash 362f6c7f...) loads, which is post-canvass. (3) The CivicPlus archive ZIPs are titled 'Official Results Reports' (post-canvass) and were not opened. (4) Check 4: two web searches; Hays Free Press 2024 coverage and Dripping Springs News 2024 results pages still return 404; search snippets give county totals 'as of 11:13 p.m.' only (not evidence). (5) phase1/targeted/archives/Hays and phase1/targeted/wayback/Hays are on the branch but hold no mementos or captures (archive.today timemaps empty; Memento aggregator unreachable). Sweep pending (no phase1/targeted/sweep/Hays on the branch at finish). Targeted pass 4 2026-10-02 (targeted4-C): no election changed; tag and results unchanged. Tried: (1) Vendor check: Hays does not use livevoterturnout.com for the three target elections; the only Hays livevoterturnout site is livevoterturnout.com/HaysTX/LiveResults (Nov 2020, already recorded), the county pages (172/Elections, Archive.aspx) and the 2026-03-03 20:35 CST capture of hayscountytx.gov/elections/20260303 link no livevoterturnout or other ENR site, only egovlink unofficial 'Cumulative Results' PDFs and an electionlink.net 'Election Day Voting Dashboard' widget (wait times), and a web search for Hays livevoterturnout election night results found none. (2) wayback-data branch re-read at start and finish (head 79216478): phase1/targeted/wayback/Hays covers livevoterturnout.com/HaysTX, hayscountytx.gov/172 and /257 with 0 captures in all three windows; phase1/targeted/archives/Hays has no mementos; no phase1/targeted/sweep/Hays (sweep pending); main harvest has only the 2026-03-03 20:35 CST capture already recorded. (3) CivicPlus 'Official Results Reports - Republican Party May 26, 2026 Primary Runoff (ZIP)' (DocumentCenter/View/1649, hash c3081eef...) holds only six 'Official Cumulative' and 'Official Canvass' files (xlsx, csv, pdf) dated 2026-06-01; no unofficial or election-night report. (4) Lead only: Hays CCS Operation Plan (egovlink .../elections/notices/CCS Operation Plan.pdf, CreationDate 2026-05-02) says 'The CCS Presiding Judge signs the printed unofficial precinct report on Election Night' and 'Unofficial results will be released via the Hays County Elections webpage beginning no earlier than 7:00 pm on Election Day. Election Day results will be released periodically as returning equipment is processed, accepted, and tabulated until completion.' It does not say whether the precinct report is posted online, so rule 43 condition (ii) still cannot be shown for the 2026 primary. (5) Two more web searches (egovlink 2024 results; hayscountytx.com 2024 unofficial precinct files) found no 2024 election-night file; the Hays Free Press 2024 coverage URL was already a recorded 404. Targeted pass 6 2026-10-03 (targeted6-A): no election changed; tag and results unchanged. Tried (third-party election-night copies): (1) County party sites: Hays County Democratic Party (haysdems.org, not WordPress) news list shows posts dated 02/19/26, 02/23/26, 03/11/26 ('Official Canvass of Primary Votes', a canvass notice), 05/01/26, 06/01/26 and 06/02/26, so nothing was posted on the 2026 primary or runoff nights and no precinct report is reposted; two web searches found no Hays County Republican Party website (old.hayscountytx.gov/external-links, which lists external links, is refused by the fetch module). (2) GitHub/civic repositories: one web search found no Hays results scraper repository; the api.github.com repository search returns HTTP 403 to the fetch module. (3) City sites (Nov 2024 joint election): WordPress media logs for 2024-11-05 to 2024-11-08: cityofhays.org holds one upload (IMG_8746.jpeg, 2024-11-06 19:36), vilbc.org none; cityofuhland.com and mountaincitytx.gov return 403, woodcreektx.gov 404, cityofniederwald.org refused; the City of Kyle election page (cityofkyle.com/election) links past results only to ecode360.com/KY6871/documents/Election_Results_Archive, which returns 403 (bot protection, not pursued). (4) Local media: web searches for Hays precinct maps or election-night precinct tables found none; haysfreepress.com/2024/11/05/november-2024-election-coverage and drippingspringsnews.com/article/2406 still return 404 (recorded dead ends); Community Impact November 2024 print edition is not an election-night publication; hayscountytx.gov DocumentCenter/View/5053 is the Nov 3 2026 vote center list (irrelevant). (5) wayback-data re-read at start and finish: phase1/targeted/sweep/Hays now present but finds 0 versions in all three windows (several CDX queries timed out). 8 web searches, 17 fetches. No third-party per-precinct candidate numbers with an election-night time were found.
